title: Eggersmann UAE – Luxury Kitchen Website
intro: A premium, bilingual WordPress website for Eggersmann UAE, focused on design fidelity and performance.
summary: Built with Elementor Pro, custom PHP, and Pods to manage Projects, Materials, and Finishes. Tuned for SEO, responsiveness, and maintainability on Cloudways (DigitalOcean).
features: Custom Elementor layouts with advanced styling and interactions
SEO foundations with schema, OG tags, and clean information architecture
Performance tuning for fast TTFB and core web vitals

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A high-end website representing Eggersmann’s luxury kitchens in the UAE, balancing visual storytelling with maintainable content workflows.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Deliver a premium digital presence and empower the team to manage Projects and Finishes without developer involvement.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: End-to-end build: CPT modeling with Pods, Elementor theming, custom PHP, SEO setup, hosting and deployment on Cloudways.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Modular templates; multilingual routing; optimized assets; structured content for scalability; consistent brand visuals.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body: Maintained performance on a flexible WP stack via query optimization, asset discipline, and caching layers.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Premium UX that matches the global brand; improved SEO visibility; content is now manageable by non-technical staff.
